component.name: CollectiveFS
component.summary: Distributed file browser and node console for CollectiveFS

description.p: CollectiveFS is a native desktop client for a CollectiveFS node: a distributed, encrypted, Reed-Solomon erasure-coded file browser with drag-and-drop upload, plus live read/write throughput and storage and shard-durability metrics. It wraps the node console in a fast native webview.
